candidates.reviewerRationale: YMX Innovation Centre is a useful research/test-centre candidate because official DND evidence places the NEXUS UxS DISH primarily at YMX in Mirabel and describes secure collaboration spaces, specialized testing infrastructure, regulated airspace, and development, testing, validation, and integration work for uncrewed and counter-uncrewed systems. The candidate is amber because the reviewer should confirm whether the map should model the physical YMX facility as the entity, with NEXUS as a program relationship, rather than creating a separate NEXUS or Aéro Montréal record.
reviewWarnings: Modeling choice needs reviewer confirmation: DND describes NEXUS as operating from YMX Innovation Centre, while Aéro Montréal and Espace Aero lead the consortium.
ADM's YMX profile is official but rendered limited static text in curl, so DND official evidence carries the strongest field-level support.
The candidate should not be accepted until the reviewer decides whether YMX, NEXUS, or Aéro Montréal is the preferred public record boundary.

fieldEvidence.excerpt: The official ADM page presents YMX Innovation as a YMX-based hub that accelerates aerospace industry transformation for civil and defence purposes.
DND states that NEXUS operates primarily from the YMX Innovation Centre in Mirabel, Quebec, with secure collaboration spaces and specialized testing infrastructure.

DND describes the hub as supporting development, testing, validation and integration, with priority areas including uncrewed and counter-uncrewed systems, human-machine teaming, contested environments and sensor integration.
DND defines DISHs as secure, mission-oriented environments for collaboration, experimentation, testing, system integration and validation of UxS and quantum technologies.
DND says the UxS DISH accelerates the development and adoption of uncrewed and autonomous technologies through trusted partners working in secure environments.
DND identifies an Espace Aero-led consortium, under Aero Montreal, as the selected UxS DISH delivery team with partners across industry, academia and not-for-profit sectors.
DND states that NEXUS complements the NRC Drone Innovation Hub operating across Ottawa and Mirabel for uncrewed and counter-drone systems research, testing and commercialization.
DARIT describes joining NEXUS at the YMX Innovation Centre and contributing a counter-UxS and robotic autonomous systems use case to the hub.
